content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends screening individuals who are at high risk for type 2 diabetes, including those with prediabetes, by utilizing risk factor-based screening tools. One such tool is the ADA risk test, which helps identify individuals who may have impaired fasting glucose (IFG) or impaired glucose tolerance (IGT). The use of A1C testing for prediabetes screening is considered both reasonable and cost-effective. This method allows for the early identification of individuals at high risk, enabling timely interventions to prevent or delay the progression to type 2 diabetes.
